burrata.name: Burrata na tomato heirloom
burrata.short: Burrata ude, tomato mfri eke, ntụ ọka esiri esi.
burrata.description: Bọọlụ dị nro nke burrata ọhụrụ, tomato heirloom dị ụtọ na basil, ejiri mmanụ olive mechaa. Wepu ya na ntụ ọka esiri esi ọkụ ọkụ.
burrata.ingredients: Burrata (mmiri ara ehi), tomato, basil, mmanụ oliv, ntụ ọka (ọka wit), nnu mmiri.

dumplings.name: Chili-ekpo ọkụ na-ekpo ọkụ
dumplings.short: Akwukwo akwukwo nri ọla edo, mmanụ chili, scallions.
dumplings.description: Mpempe akwụkwọ nri nwere pan isii nwere ala dị nro na etiti dị nro. Emechara ya na mmanụ chili na scallions, na-etinye soy sauce n'akụkụ.
dumplings.ingredients: Ihe mkpuchi ọka wit, kabeeji, mushrooms, karọt, scallions, soy sauce (soy, wheat), sesame, mmanụ chili.

pasta.name: Tomato na basil rigatoni
pasta.short: Tomato a ṅara n'ọkụ, basil ọhụrụ, parmesan.
pasta.description: Pasta a na-ekpo ọkụ wụsara n'ime ihendori tomato bara ụba, nke na-adị ngwa ngwa, ya na basil ọhụrụ na parmesan anaghị eri anụ. Na-akasi obi, dị mfe, ma mee ogologo nri ehihie.
pasta.ingredients: Rigatoni (ọka wit), tomato, basil, onye anaghị eri anụ parmesan (mmiri ara ehi), mmanụ oliv, galik.

salad.name: nnukwu efere ubi a ṅara n'ọkụ
salad.short: Akwụkwọ nri a ṅara n'ọkụ, chickpeas, citrus na herbs.
salad.description: Beet a ṅara n'ọkụ na nduku dị ụtọ n'elu akwụkwọ ndụ akwụkwọ ndụ kpụ ọkụ n'ọnụ, ya na chickpeas, citrus na-egbuke egbuke na ahịhịa ọhụrụ. Ihe mgbakwasa lemon na-ejikọta ya niile.
salad.ingredients: Beets, poteto ụtọ, chickpeas, citrus, elu, pasili, Mint, sesame, lemon, mmanụ oliv.

chicken.name: Lemọn na ọkụkọ ahịhịa
chicken.short: Ọkụkọ ọla edo, poteto nwa, agwa ndụ ndụ.
chicken.description: Ọkụkọ a ṅara n'ọkụ ahịhịa nwere akpụkpọ kpụ ọkụ n'ọnụ, poteto ụmụaka na agwa ndụ ndụ. Ejiri obere lemon na mmanụ oliv mee ya.
chicken.ingredients: Chicken, poteto, agwa ndụ ndụ, lemon, mmanụ oliv, rosemary, thyme, galik.

cake.name: Chocolate ganache achicha
cake.short: Chocolate gbara ọchịchịrị, ude vanilla, utu ọhụrụ.
cake.description: Iberibe achịcha chọkọletị bara ụba nke nwere ganache chocolate gbara ọchịchịrị na-egbuke egbuke. Obere ude vanilla na utu ohuru n'akụkụ.
cake.ingredients: Chocolate, ntụ ọka wit, àkwá, bọta (mmiri ara ehi), ude (mmiri ara ehi), sugar, vanilla, raspberry.

lemonade.name: Strawberry basil lemonade
lemonade.short: Strawberry ọhụrụ, lemon, basil na mmiri na-egbuke egbuke.
lemonade.description: lemonade na-egbuke egbuke, na-egbuke egbuke nke nwere strawberries ọhụrụ, mpịakọta nke lemon na basil na-esi ísì ụtọ. Ejere ya n'elu ice.
lemonade.ingredients: Strawberry, lemon, basil, sugar cane, mmiri na-egbuke egbuke, ice.

tea.name: Jasmine gbazere tii
tea.short: Ifuru jasmine tii, lemon, ọtụtụ ice.
tea.description: Tii jasmine a kpụchara ọhụrụ, ajụ oyi ma jiri lemon mee ihe n'elu ice. Adịghị ụtọ, nke nwere ifuru dị nro.
tea.ingredients: Jasmine tii, lemon, mmiri akọrọ, ice. Nwere caffeine.
